name: PURSE-BACK-check-gone
why: the rollback asked when the clean save is from after the wrap - it lands after the sale, undoing play and giving nothing back

name: PURSE-BACK-equal-clean-passes
why: a clean save at the purse's own sequence passed

name: PURSE-BACK-latest-gold-read
why: the latest gold finding read as the first - a clean save between two of them passed

name: PURSE-BACK-rolled-back-unsaid
why: a run applied twice told the purse was set at nothing since

name: PURSE-BACK-any-of-several
why: the first of several wrapped characters rolled back, unasked

name: PURSE-BACK-another-accounts
old: character ? result.characters.find((/** @type {any} */ c) => c.id === character) : below
new: character ? result.characters.find((/** @type {any} */ c) => c.id === character) ?? below[0] : below
why: a character named that is not the account's - the account's first wrapped one rolled back instead

name: PURSE-BACK-note-without-run
why: the staff finding forgets which run wrote it

name: PURSE-BACK-dry-writes
why: the dry run writes the rollback

name: PURSE-BACK-dry-write-for-rows
old: if (dry && WRITES.test(sql)) throw new Error('wranglerD1: a write asked for rows - a dry binding cannot answer it');
why: a write asked for its rows runs on a dry binding

name: PURSE-BACK-count-assumed
why: a guarded write that moved nothing answered as landed - the staff finding written for a rollback that did not happen

name: PURSE-BACK-quoted-placeholder-bound
old: if (c === "'" || c === '"') { quote = c; out += c; continue; }
new: if (c === '"') { quote = c; out += c; continue; }
why: a ? inside a string literal bound as a parameter - every bind after it shifts

name: PURSE-BACK-bare-mark-numbered-wrong
why: a bare ? after a numbered one bound the first value, not SQLite's next

name: PURSE-BACK-binds-left-over
old: if (top !== args.length) throw new Error(`literalSql: ${args.length} bound, ${top} asked`);
why: a bind no placeholder asks for passed silently, where D1 refuses the statement

name: PURSE-BACK-missing-key-throws
why: a save the bucket lost throws, where the binding answers null and the act says no-clean

name: PURSE-BACK-command-in-the-log
why: a failure's message carries its statement - an account's id on a public run's page

name: PURSE-BACK-apply-by-default
old:
required: true
        default: false
        type: boolean
new:
required: true
        default: true
        type: boolean
why: a run by hand writes unless told not to

name: PURSE-BACK-actor-typed
why: the act recorded as the owner's whoever ran it

name: PURSE-BACK-input-spliced
why: an input pasted into the script - a shell command anyone who can start the run can type

name: PURSE-BACK-page-lost
why: the run's page says nothing of what the act answered
